title: Banking Tribunals Validation of Orders Act 1994

sections.shortTitle: Banking Tribunals Validation of Orders Act 1994
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT V OF 1994
ACT V OF 1994
BANKING TRIBUNALS (VALIDATION OF ORDERS) ACT, 1994
An Act to validate certain orders passed by the Banking Tribunals
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 19th May, 1994]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 18th
May, 1994, and is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title, extent and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Banking Tribunals (Validation of Orders) Act, 1994.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Banking Tribunals Validation of Orders Act 1994
sections.description:
Validation

ACT V OF 1994
ACT V OF 1994
BANKING TRIBUNALS (VALIDATION OF ORDERS) ACT, 1994
An Act to validate certain orders passed by the Banking Tribunals
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 19th May, 1994]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 18th
May, 1994, and is hereby published for general information:--
2. Validation.---Notwithstanding any order or decision of any
Court, any order or judgment passed, decision or proceeding taken or recoveries
made by the Banking Tribunal under the Banking Tribunals (Amendment) Act, 1992
(IV of 1992), or any appointment made or notification issued thereunder, at any
time before the commencement of this Ordinance and purporting to be in exercise
of the authority conferred on the Banking Tribunal under the said Act shall be
deemed to have been validly made, passed or taken and shall have, and shall be
deemed always to have had, affect accordingly.
